overall.verdict: Flagship-verified. Every dimension independently clears the >=5 signature-move gate (>=3 concrete on-page evidence items AND a handled category-typical failure mode each) — this is a genuine multi-signature flagship, not a manufactured or rounded-up pass. Defining moves: (1) the reveal-protected strip-the-diaspora hero (int_01) that makes the reader PRODUCE the 15/26 + 50.3%-of-caps + 3-of-4-goals collapse by their own hand, landing before the prose ever states the number; (2) the three-layer counting honesty (UN floor / census / heritage) turned into the narrative spine, with the four missing host countries drawn as ghosted markers rather than silently omitted; (3) a fully public, re-runnable Elo/ordered-logit model with an honest out-of-sample validation and its material caveats surviving verbatim into visible prose. No send-backs.

evidence: Non-obvious reframe that updates a careful reader: 'plucky minnow' is replaced by a 500-year, famine-born, remittance-financed, constitutionally-engineered emigration SYSTEM that the strictest count in the world (the UN matrix) literally cannot fully see — the thesis 'Cape Verde is bigger than Cape Verde' is earned, not asserted.

Exactly ONE earned HERO centerpiece landing AT/BEFORE the reveal: int_01 (edt_03) lets the reader switch off the five foreign birth countries and watch 15 players / 50.3% of caps / 3 of 4 World Cup goals vanish, banner 'The team that qualified stops existing.' — the reader produces the central finding themselves; the standfirst and edt_01/edt_02 never leak 15/26 or 57.7% (reveal protection verified in copywriter.json + auditor static_checks).

Earned supporting SET (R8 / C-ABUNDANCE), each bound to a DISTINCT producible finding, all 10 playtest PASS with 0 recompute disagreements: int_02 odds explorer (re-run the night / re-match anyone left in the draw), int_03 map scrolly (the holes in the count), int_04 Sao Tome decline, int_05 zero-club guess, int_06 remittance-rank climb, int_07 27.9-per-100 guess, int_08 5.1x scale guess, int_09 Elo climb, int_10 find-your-country population strip — coverage of distinct findings, not a widget-pile (a clear dominant hero exists).

Honest validation of a modelled/predictive headline (honest_accuracy_cap PASS): ana_20 out-of-sample calibration — trained 1990-2014, scored on 10,681 unseen matches, Brier 18.8% better than base-rate, calibration within 2.5 pts per decile — is stated WITH the naive baseline and a falsification condition ('what would falsify it is a decile table where longshots won far more often; that table does not exist here'); the decile table ships in the noscript.

material_caveat_survival PASS — every material limitation reaches VISIBLE prose, not just the JSONs: 'our own Elo implementation, not comparable with published boards' (edt_02 + every layer-chip + chart caption); 'extra time as a coin flip is an assumption, not a measurement -> 7.6% advance' (edt_02 + int_02 micro-copy); the LAYER RULE (UN-floor / census / heritage never mixed, layer-chips on every chart); the four missing hosts (NL/US/Spain/Senegal) drawn as ghosted 'no row' markers on int_03; 'a floor by construction, no other row'; Vozinha 40-not-39; Brazil x286 flagged as a small-base artifact.

Every quantitative claim is bounded and level-appropriate: 8.3% is explicitly 'level after 90 minutes' (not 'chance of advancing'), 7.6% is the coin-flip-adjusted advance with the assumption named; 27.9 is 'the strictest of three layers, not the diaspora'; the emigration rank is stated as '#20 of the 212 World Bank-covered origins' (the exact validated granularity, with the Puerto Rico/Somalia join-exclusion honoured), never a raw world rank.

The headline actively bounds its own scope: the 'fusion, not an imported XI' counterweight (island-born Ryan Mendes holds the all-time cap+goal records, the captain is island-born, 11 of 26 born on the archipelago) prevents the diaspora thesis from over-reaching into 'a Dutch team'.

Correlation is not dressed as causation and partial-period/small-sample flags are explicit: the remittance dip is read correctly ('a denominator transformed by tourism-led growth, not a diaspora gone quiet', proven by the 2021 pandemic re-rise); 'as of 2026-07-03' conventions; live R16 status is dated display-only, never fed to the model or headlined; Northern Ireland 1982 named as an honest exclusion.
